## Summary

- describe the product or template change
- explain why the change belongs in the starter

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`

## Template Checklist

- [ ] Updated `.env.local.example` for any new environment variables
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if setup, usage, or extension guidance changed
- [ ] Updated `ARCHITECTURE.md` or `CONVENTIONS.md` if repo rules or boundaries changed
- [ ] Kept provider logic behind internal helpers instead of scattering vendor APIs
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the real implementation behavior

## Notes

- list any follow-up work or intentional non-goals
